description: Data and code underlying the publication: How battery energy storage impacts grid congestion – An evaluation of the trade-offs between different battery control strategies is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Christian van Someren. The goal of this research was to evaluate the effects of different battery control strategies on battery performance and battery grid impacts. This dataset contains the code and data necessary to simulate power flows on a distribution grid in a rural village in the Netherlands, including interactions with household batteries. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
